Date: 25/08/2026

To
The Head of the Department
Department of Computer Science & Engineering
Vignan’s Foundation for Science, Technology & Research (VFSTR)

Subject: Request for Grant of On-Duty (OD) to Students Who Participated in Agentic AI Hackathon – 2026

Respected Sir,

The Agentic AI Hackathon – 2026 provided students an opportunity to build innovative web-based projects integrating AI technologies, tools, APIs, and AI Agents. Participants developed practical solutions to real-world problems, with their projects scheduled for presentation and evaluation on 29 August 2026.

Hence, we kindly request you to grant On-Duty (OD) attendance to the listed students for the respective dates and periods to facilitate the updating of their attendance records.

The list of participating students is enclosed for your kind consideration.

Thank you for your consideration.

Yours sincerely,

AI Champions
Department of Computer Science & Engineering
VFSTR

Enclosure: List of students who attended the Agentic AI Hackathon – 2026
